- Fullscreen (landscape) video fills the whole screen again, including the area around the camera cutout, instead of leaving a black bar there.
- You can now play a video during a phone or WhatsApp call. The video's audio plays alongside the call, like YouTube.
- Fixes the version shown in Android's app info: v1.5.7 was still labelled 1.5.6.

Installs over v1.1.0 and later directly. If you're still on v1.0.0, uninstall it first; it was signed with a different key.
